blocks.en: The inequality in 1 is referred to as Bessel\textquotesingle s inequality, or, in the case where equality holds, as Parseval\textquotesingle s equality.
blocks.zh: 条件 1 中的不等式称为 Bessel 不等式, 或者在等号成立时称为 Parseval 等式.

blocks.en:
For finite subsets $J$ of $I$ we can use the fact that $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ is an orthonormal set to get the following:\[
\begin{aligned}
0&\leq\left\|x-\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)x_i\right\|^2\\
&=\left(x-\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)x_i,x-\sum_{l\in J}(x_l,x)x_l\right)\\
&=\|x\|^2-\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)(x,x_i)-\sum_{l\in J}(x,x_l)(x_l,x)\\
&\quad+\left(\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)x_i,\sum_{l\in J}(x_l,x)x_l\right)\\
&=\|x\|^2-2\sum_{i\in J}|(x_i,x)|^2+\sum_{i\in J}\sum_{l\in J}\overline{(x_i,x)}(x_l,x)(x_i,x_l)\\
&=\|x\|^2-\sum_{i\in J}|(x_i,x)|^2.
\end{aligned}
\]Hence $\sum_{i\in I}|(x_i,x)|^2$ exists, and Bessel\textquotesingle s inequality holds. By Lemma~\ref{lem:orthogonal-series-summability}, this implies that $\sum_{i\in I}(x_i,x)x_i$ also exists. Moreover, using the argument above,
\begin{equation}\label{eq:orthonormal-expansion-remainder-norm-identity}
\left\|x-\sum_{i\in I}(x_i,x)x_i\right\|^2=\|x\|^2-\sum_{i\in I}|(x_i,x)|^2,
\end{equation}
and the second claim of the theorem is immediate.
blocks.zh:
对 $I$ 的有限子集 $J$, 利用 $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ 是标准正交集这一事实, 得到:\[
\begin{aligned}
0&\leq\left\|x-\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)x_i\right\|^2\\
&=\left(x-\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)x_i,x-\sum_{l\in J}(x_l,x)x_l\right)\\
&=\|x\|^2-\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)(x,x_i)-\sum_{l\in J}(x,x_l)(x_l,x)\\
&\quad+\left(\sum_{i\in J}(x_i,x)x_i,\sum_{l\in J}(x_l,x)x_l\right)\\
&=\|x\|^2-2\sum_{i\in J}|(x_i,x)|^2+\sum_{i\in J}\sum_{l\in J}\overline{(x_i,x)}(x_l,x)(x_i,x_l)\\
&=\|x\|^2-\sum_{i\in J}|(x_i,x)|^2.
\end{aligned}
\]因而 $\sum_{i\in I}|(x_i,x)|^2$ 存在, 且 Bessel 不等式成立. 由 Lemma~\ref{lem:orthogonal-series-summability}, 这意味着 $\sum_{i\in I}(x_i,x)x_i$ 也存在. 此外, 利用上述论证,
\begin{equation}\label{eq:orthonormal-expansion-remainder-norm-identity}
\left\|x-\sum_{i\in I}(x_i,x)x_i\right\|^2=\|x\|^2-\sum_{i\in I}|(x_i,x)|^2,
\end{equation}
该定理的第二个断言立即得出.

blocks.en: An orthonormal set $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ in a Hilbert space $H$ is called a \textbf{basis} if $x=\sum_{i\in I}(x_i,x)x_i$ for every $x\in H$.
blocks.zh: 若对每个 $x\in H$ 都有 $x=\sum_{i\in I}(x_i,x)x_i$, 则称 Hilbert 空间 $H$ 中的标准正交集 $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ 为一组\textbf{基}.
blocks.label: def:hilbert-basis

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In contrast to the usual definition of a vector space basis, we are allowing infinite series in the representation of $x$ as a linear combination of the $x_i$. If there is danger of confusion, then a basis in the sense of Definition~\ref{def:hilbert-basis} is called a Hilbert basis, whereas a vector space basis in the sense of finite linear combinations is called a Hamel basis. In the following, a basis is always a Hilbert basis.
blocks.zh: 与向量空间基的通常定义不同, 在将 $x$ 表示为 $x_i$ 的线性组合时允许无穷级数. 若可能混淆, 则将 Definition~\ref{def:hilbert-basis} 意义下的基称为 Hilbert 基, 而将有限线性组合意义下的向量空间基称为 Hamel 基. 以下所说的基总是 Hilbert 基.
